gameDescriptionHtml:
Wildwood Down is a charming adventure about a chummy high school senior with Down syndrome who gets thrown head first into a murder mystery along the boardwalk of Wildwood, New Jersey.

With his sister’s life on the line, Dan must unravel the case all while navigating eccentric characters and his own unique perspective before time runs out!

Can this unlikely hero outsmart the danger lurking beneath the cheerful facade of America’s favorite seaside destination?

Cheeky Puzzles add to the humorous dichotomy of the world of Wildwood Down. The protagonist Daniel finds himself making donuts, winning an underground wrestling tournament, and getting thrown out of bars in-order to unveil the murderer of his good friend and hopefully save his sister.

A Fun-tastic Coastal environment with attractive 2D/3D Art. The visuals are a “first-in-it’s-class” for the P&C genre. A combination of 2D pixel and 3D graphics with a unique art style that presents eye popping scenery. Wildwood Down pulls players into it’s world: cinematic camera work, a 3d soundscape, full character voice acting, and rich retrograde pixel art.

An engaging journey with “Daniel” and his eccentric friends. Provides an immersive adventure with quirky but lovable characters full of jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes. Be ‘Dan,’ and unravel the sinister plot of the “Boardwalk Butcher” and help the high school seniors party on and save your sister!

Game Features

  • 8-10+ hours of Story-Driven Gameplay
  • A Full Cast of Professional Voice Talent
  • Original Soundtrack “Surf Rock Noir” (Live Instruments)
  • Funny Rewarding Puzzles with Minimal “Moon Logic”
  • Retro Hand Drawn frame-by-frame Pixel Art
  • Full Controller Support (Designed with Steam-Deck in mind)
  • Cinematic 3d – Camera Work / Sound / Lighting
